name: NavList
label: Nav list
description: Vertical list of navigation links for drawers and menus, with three indent levels and per-row expand toggles.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: href of the current page — the exactly matching row gets `aria-current="page"` and the active treatment.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Controlled list of expanded item ids.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Fires with the full new list of expanded ids whenever a toggle is pressed, in both controlled and uncontrolled modes.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several sections expanded at once. Default false — expanding one collapses the rest.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Fires when any link is clicked, alongside native navigation — e.g. to close the drawer that contains the list.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a collapsed section's chevron toggle, given the row's label. Defaults to "Expand <label>".

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of an expanded section's chevron toggle, given the row's label. Defaults to "Collapse <label>".

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; passed on to each row's Button. Wins over a
LinkProvider's; a plain `<a>` when neither is set.
